name: n3memorycore-lite
description: Working memory for AI agents (Claude Code) — ephemeral (7-day TTL) hybrid vector + BM25 memory, backed by Redis Stack. Session-scoped by design; pair with the paid N3MemoryCore Pro server for long-term persistent knowledge. Persistence is disabled and enforced by the server (AOF off, RDB off). Prerequisites: (1) Redis Stack on localhost:6379 (docker run -d --name redis-stack -p 6379:6379 redis/redis-stack-server:latest) and (2) uv on PATH (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).
